name: Antigua and Barbuda
hint: two small islands in the Leeward Islands, east of Puerto Rico
facts: Antigua is said to have 365 beaches, one for every day of the year.
Codrington Lagoon on Barbuda has the Caribbean's largest frigatebird colony.
asks: Which country is said to have a beach for every day of the year?
Which country has the largest frigatebird colony in the Caribbean, at Codrington Lagoon?

name: Bahamas
hint: a long chain of islands just east of Florida
facts: On Big Major Cay in the Bahamas, pigs swim out to meet passing boats.
The flamingo is the national bird of the Bahamas.
asks: In which country do pigs swim out to meet boats at Big Major Cay?
Which country has the flamingo as its national bird?

name: Barbados
hint: a small coral island out in the Atlantic, east of the other Caribbean islands
facts: Barbados's flag shows the black head of a trident, the spear of the sea god Neptune.
Barbados's national dish is cou-cou and flying fish.
asks: Which country's flag shows the black head of a trident?
Which country has cou-cou and flying fish as its national dish?

name: Belize
hint: a small country on the Caribbean coast, between Mexico and Guatemala
facts: The Great Blue Hole, a giant round sinkhole in the sea, lies off the coast of Belize.
Belize is the only country in Central America with English as its official language.
asks: Which country has the Great Blue Hole, a giant round sinkhole in the sea?
Which country in Central America has English as its official language?

name: Canada
hint: a huge northern country that stretches from the Atlantic to the Pacific and up to the Arctic
facts: Canada has the longest coastline of any country in the world.
Canada's flag shows a red maple leaf.
asks: Which country has the longest coastline in the world?
Which country's flag shows a red maple leaf?

name: Costa Rica
hint: a green country of rainforests and volcanoes between Nicaragua and Panama
facts: "Costa Rica" means "rich coast" in Spanish.
The misty Monteverde Cloud Forest grows high in the mountains of Costa Rica.
asks: Which country's name means "rich coast" in Spanish?
Which country is home to the misty Monteverde Cloud Forest?

name: Cuba
hint: the largest island in the Caribbean, just south of Florida
facts: Cuba is the largest island in the Caribbean.
The bee hummingbird, the world's smallest bird, lives only in Cuba.
asks: Which country is the largest island in the Caribbean?
Which country is the only home of the bee hummingbird, the world's smallest bird?

name: Dominica
hint: a steep green island between Guadeloupe and Martinique
facts: Dominica's Boiling Lake is the second-largest hot lake in the world.
Dominica's flag shows a Sisserou parrot, the island's national bird.
asks: Which country has a steaming Boiling Lake, the second largest of its kind in the world?
Which country's flag shows a Sisserou parrot?

name: Dominican Republic
hint: the eastern part of Hispaniola, an island shared by two countries
facts: Pico Duarte in the Dominican Republic is the highest mountain in the Caribbean.
Merengue, a fast and joyful music and dance, comes from the Dominican Republic.
asks: Which country has the highest mountain in the Caribbean?
Which country is the home of merengue music and dance?

name: El Salvador
hint: the only country in Central America with no Caribbean coast
facts: El Salvador is the smallest country in Central America by area.
Pupusas, thick corn cakes stuffed with cheese or beans, are the national dish of El Salvador.
asks: Which country is the smallest in Central America by area?
Pupusas, thick stuffed corn cakes, are the national dish of which country?
hint2: This is the smallest country in Central America.

name: Grenada
hint: a small island in the southern Caribbean, just north of Trinidad
facts: Grenada's flag shows a nutmeg, one of the spices the island is famous for.
Grenada's Molinière Bay has an underwater sculpture park, often called the world's first.
asks: Which country's flag shows a nutmeg?
Which country has an underwater sculpture park at Molinière Bay?

name: Guatemala
hint: a land of volcanoes and Maya temples, just south of Mexico
facts: Tikal, an ancient Maya city in Guatemala, has temples that rise above the jungle trees.
Guatemala's money, the quetzal, is named after its bright green national bird.
asks: Which country is home to the ancient Maya city of Tikal?
Which country's money is named after a bright green bird?
hint2: Volcanoes rise near the highland capital of this country.

name: Haiti
hint: the western part of Hispaniola, an island shared by two countries
facts: Haiti's name comes from a Taíno word meaning "land of high mountains."
Soup joumou, a pumpkin soup, is a New Year's Day tradition in Haiti.
asks: Which country's name comes from a Taíno word meaning "land of high mountains"?
In which country do families eat soup joumou, a pumpkin soup, on New Year's Day?

name: Honduras
hint: a Central American country with a long Caribbean coast, between Guatemala and Nicaragua
facts: Copán, an ancient Maya city in Honduras, has a stone stairway carved with the longest known Maya text.
The scarlet macaw is the national bird of Honduras.
asks: Which country is home to the ancient Maya city of Copán, with its carved stone stairway?
Which country has the scarlet macaw as its national bird?

name: Jamaica
hint: a mountainous Caribbean island just south of Cuba
facts: Reggae music comes from Jamaica.
Jamaica's flag is black, green and gold, with no red, white or blue.
asks: Which island country is the home of reggae music?
Which country's flag is black and green, crossed by a gold X?

name: Mexico
hint: a large country just south of the United States, with coasts on the Pacific and the Caribbean
facts: Every winter, millions of monarch butterflies from Canada and the United States gather in the mountain forests of Mexico.
Mexico's flag shows an eagle on a cactus, holding a snake.
asks: In which country's mountain forests do millions of monarch butterflies gather each winter?
Which country's flag shows an eagle on a cactus, holding a snake?
hint2: The capital of this country stands on the site of the old Aztec city of Tenochtitlan.

name: Nicaragua
hint: a land of lakes and volcanoes between Honduras and Costa Rica
facts: Lake Nicaragua is the largest lake in Central America.
Ometepe, in Lake Nicaragua, is an island made of two volcanoes.
asks: Which country has the largest lake in Central America?
Which country has Ometepe, an island of two volcanoes rising from a lake?

name: Panama
hint: a narrow country that links Central America and South America
facts: The Panama Canal lets ships cross between the Atlantic and Pacific Oceans.
The golden frog is a national symbol of Panama, with its own special day each August.
asks: Which country has a canal that joins the Atlantic and Pacific Oceans?
Which country has a golden frog as a national symbol?
hint2: A famous canal cuts across this narrow country.

name: Saint Kitts and Nevis
hint: two small volcanic islands in the Leeward Islands
facts: Saint Kitts and Nevis is the smallest country in the Americas, by both area and population.
Alexander Hamilton, a founder of the United States, was born on the island of Nevis.
asks: Which is the smallest country in the Americas?
Alexander Hamilton, a founder of the United States, was born on an island in which country?

name: Saint Lucia
hint: a green volcanic island between Martinique and Saint Vincent
facts: The Pitons are two steep volcanic peaks rising beside the sea in Saint Lucia.
Saint Lucia's Sulphur Springs is often called a drive-in volcano.
asks: Which country has the Pitons, two steep volcanic peaks beside the sea?
Which country's Sulphur Springs is often called a drive-in volcano?

name: Saint Vincent and the Grenadines
hint: a volcanic island with a chain of smaller islands trailing south toward Grenada
facts: Wallilabou Bay on Saint Vincent was a filming location for the first Pirates of the Caribbean movie.
The botanic gardens in Kingstown were started in 1765, making them among the oldest in the Americas.
asks: Which country has Wallilabou Bay, a filming location for the first Pirates of the Caribbean movie?
Which country has botanic gardens in Kingstown that were started in 1765?

name: Trinidad and Tobago
hint: two islands just off the coast of Venezuela, at the south end of the Caribbean
facts: The steelpan, a musical drum made from steel barrels, was developed in Trinidad and Tobago.
Pitch Lake in Trinidad is the world's largest natural deposit of asphalt.
asks: In which country was the steelpan, a musical drum made from steel barrels, developed?
Which country has Pitch Lake, the world's largest natural deposit of asphalt?

name: United States
hint: a big country with 50 states, between Canada and Mexico
facts: Yellowstone, often called the world's first national park, is in the United States.
The flag of the United States has 50 stars, one for each state.
asks: Which country is home to Yellowstone, often called the world's first national park?
Which country's flag has 50 stars, one for each of its states?
